Nothing for Leskovac after 1857 on FamilySearch. PAGING ATTEMPT 17 Oct 2026 (not a nil, no entry for Vid found): jumped to images 12, 60, 120, 200, 260, 330 only. Image 12/60/120 = tabular Latin births spreads (~12 entries a page); image 60 reads as 1840-43 and shows the parish priest "Ladislaus Jagodić, Par. Loci"; image 200 = prose-style entries (Spudich names visible; possibly deaths); image 260 = tabular again; image 330 = a certification leaf with stamp (a book boundary). Images 180 and 240 did not finish loading. Viewer needs ~3x zoom and 4+ screenshots per spread to read, so a full read is impractical here. If Vid was born 8 Jan 1828 (Karen), his baptism predates this volume (births start 1832); the useful targets are his MARRIAGE(S) 1832-1857 (he may have had a first wife, so the four siblings could be half-siblings) and his death if before 1858. Section boundaries not yet mapped. MARRIAGE-SECTION MAP 17 Oct 2026 (second session, still NOT a nil): the volume's sections are not in the order the title lists. Marriages (Vjenčani, tabular Latin, columns end 'Character Copulantis', ~8-10 entries per spread) run through roughly images 450-510: image 450 ~1835, 480 = Nov 1843, 490 = 1849, 491-494 = 1851, 500 = Jan 1854 (priest Ladislaus Jagodić as officiant throughout). Births are tabular with 'Baptizantis' column (image 400 = Jan 1846). Deaths: prose Latin at image 520 (Spudich/Spudić surnames common there), tabular Croatian 'Defuncti' at image 620 (1850). Approx 1850 marriages start at image ~490; 1857 probably ends before ~515 (end not pinned). Images actually looked at: 490, 491, 492, 493, 494 (1849-1851 marriages) - handwriting too blurry in the 900x650 browser viewer to read surnames reliably; no Spudić/Polović bride or groom was positively read, but that is NOT a nil. Unread: marriages 1850 (part), 1852-1857 (about images 495-515) and 1832-1849 (about 440-490). Next step: download the images (needs the user's OK) or read with a full-resolution viewer. ONLINE TREES 17 Oct 2026 (unsourced, leads only): MyHeritage/FamilySearch Family Tree put Vid b.8 Jan 1828 Leskovac Barilovićki as son of Johannes 'Janko' Spudić (c.1801, d. before 1851) & Ana Pavletić, husband of Jelena Aršulić; Curlovic tree says he d. '1869?', which cannot be the father of a man born c.1889-91, so the 1828 Vid is at most a grandfather/uncle line. No tree found naming a Vid or Stephen as Janko's father.
